allowed_values: Do you have or simultaneously applied any group insurance cover which is linked to this loan/mortgage with Axis Max Life Insurance or any other Life insurance company?
Have you ever been convicted or are you under investigation for any criminal charges?

Have you consulted any doctor for treatment or are under treatment for any ailment other than common cough/cold or undergone any surgical operation at a hospital/clinic or undergone any investigations with other than normal or negative results (including X rays, ECG, blood tests, biopsies, etc.) or have you been absent from work due to any illness or injury for a continuous period of more than 7 days during the last 5 years or have any surgery planned or are you currently aware that you may need to seek medical advice in the near future?

Have you ever been diagnosed with or received treatment for any disability or medical condition such as but not limited to: (a) Heart disease, stroke, cancer/tumor, kidney disease, lung disease/asthma/tuberculosis, liver disease/hepatitis; (b) Diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol; (c) HIV/AIDS infection/sexually transmitted infections; (d) Congenital defect/genetic disorders/physical deformity/autoimmune, genitourinary/any disease or disorder of hearing, speech or vision excluding refractive errors; (e) Paralysis, epilepsy, any mental/psychiatric disorder, any disorder of brain/nervous system; (f) Arthritis, disorder of muscles/bones/joints, blood disorder, thyroid disorder, chronic digestive disorder, endocrine disorder?

Have any of your applications, including applications for life, critical illness, health, accident or any other riders including simultaneous/renewals/revivals ever been declined, deferred, withdrawn or accepted at extra premium or reduced cover or offered any special terms by Axis Max Life Insurance or any other insurance company in India or overseas?

Have you ever been involved or planning to be involved in an occupation, sport or hobby of a dangerous or hazardous nature such as mining, diving, mountaineering, parachuting, private aviation, racing, etc.?
Do you: (a) consume more than 10 cigarettes or bidis per day; or (b) chew more than 5 pouches of tobacco per day; or (c) consume more than 2 pegs of alcohol per day?
Do you currently or have you ever used any narcotics or any other drug?

Do you currently or have you ever used any narcotics or any other drug?

I hereby declare that:
1) I do not have any Life or Health Insurance Policy issued/pending/lapsed with Axis Max Life Insurance Limited or with any other company. If yes, please provide the proposal/Policy/Application number.
2) I do not have any or simultaneously applied any group insurance cover which is linked to this loan/mortgage with Axis Max Life Insurance or any other life insurance company.
3) In the last 2 years, I have not had a reduction in weight (of more than 10 kg), nor have I consulted a doctor for treatment or am under treatment for any ailment other than common cough/cold, nor undergone any surgical operation at a hospital/clinic, nor undergone any investigations with other than normal or negative results (including X-rays, ECG, blood tests, biopsies, etc.), nor been absent from work/hospitalized due to any illness or injury for a continuous period of more than 7 days during the last 5 years. I do not have any surgery planned nor am I currently aware that I may need to seek medical advice in the near future.
4) I have never been diagnosed with or received treatment for any disability or medical condition such as, but not limited to:
a) Heart disease, stroke, cancer/tumor/lump, kidney disease, urinary tract disease, lung disease/asthma/tuberculosis, liver disease/hepatitis
b) Diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, prostate or gynecological disorder, gastrointestinal diseases
c) HIV/AIDS infection or sexually transmitted infections
d) Congenital defect/genetic disorders/physical deformity/autoimmune/genitourinary disorders or any disease or disorder of hearing, speech or vision excluding refractive errors
e) Paralysis in any form, epilepsy, any mental/psychiatric disorder, any disorder of brain/cerebrovascular disease or nervous system
f) Arthritis, disorder of spine/muscles/bones/joints, blood disorder, thyroid disorder, chronic digestive disorder, endocrine disorder
5) None of my applications, including applications for life, critical illness, health, accident or any other riders including simultaneous/renewals/revivals, has ever been declined, deferred, withdrawn, accepted at extra premium, reduced cover, or offered special terms by Axis Max Life Insurance or any other insurance company in India or overseas.
6) I have never been involved or planning to be involved in an occupation, sport or hobby of a dangerous or hazardous nature such as mining, diving, mountaineering, parachuting, private aviation, racing, etc.
7) I do not consume alcohol more than 100 ml of wine/day, 1000 ml of beer/day or 60 ml of hard liquor/day, nor smoke tobacco more than 10 cigarettes/day or chew more than 10 sachets/day or consume it in any other form.
8) I do not consume drugs like Cannabis/Marijuana/Ecstasy/Heroin/LSD/Amphetamines or any other illegal drugs.
9) I have never ever been convicted or been under investigation for any criminal charges.
10) I have not travelled, nor intend to travel or reside abroad other than on a holiday of more than 4 weeks in the next 12 months.
11) The Insured/Proposer/Joint Life/Nominee/Payor is not a Politically Exposed Person.

If the answer to any of the above questions is No, please provide complete details.
